summary: Well-maintained and fast, but it implements defaults semantics rather than overwrite merge, and it has no publish workflow. Keep it for filling defaults only; do not adopt it for this task.
reasoning: Target values win, so defu(defaults, overrides) does not apply overrides; that is the wrong behaviour for this requirement.
Zero dependencies and good TypeScript types.
No provenance: 6.1.7 has no SLSA attestation.
Repository CI runs lint, build, type tests and coverage only; there is no publish job, so releases are cut manually.
22 open pull requests, 16 older than 90 days.
caveats: Defaults semantics differ from every other candidate; mixing them in one codebase invites subtle bugs.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: ci.yml runs lint, build, test:types and vitest with coverage. No release or publish job.

evidence.label: Merge semantics
evidence.detail: Defaults merge: existing target values are never overwritten. Not suitable for applying overrides.
